mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, u.username, r.book_id, b.title AS book_title, b.cover AS book_cover, b.isbn AS book_isbn, c.name AS category_name, r.borrow_time, r.due_time, r.return_time, r.status, (r.status = 0 AND r.due_time < NOW()) AS overdue FROM borrow_record r LEFT JOIN book b ON b.id = r.book_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = r.user_id

where.if: AND (b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_record (user_id, book_id, borrow_time, due_time, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{borrowTime}, #{dueTime}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE borrow_record SET status = 2 WHERE status = 0 AND due_time < NOW()
